findings.endpoint: prevention of frequent acute respiratory tract infections in children
findings.finding_summary: This Cochrane review found no randomized controlled trials meeting its inclusion criteria and concluded there is insufficient evidence to assess the benefits or harms of oral Astragalus as a sole intervention for preventing frequent respiratory infections in children.
findings.limitations: empty review: zero eligible trials through the December 2015 search date

findings.endpoint: common cold symptom duration in children and adolescents
findings.finding_summary: In this randomized double-masked placebo-controlled trial of 249 school-age participants, zinc gluconate glycine lozenges were reported as not effective in treating cold symptoms, in contrast to adult trials of similar lozenges.
findings.limitations: n=249; zinc gluconate glycine lozenge formulation; authors call for virologic-testing studies

findings.finding_summary: In this randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial, the day-5 sum of symptom intensity differences was reported as 12.5 ± 4.4 points with EPs 7630 versus 8.8 ± 6.8 with placebo, indicating greater symptom improvement.
The same trial reported 90.4% of EPs 7630 participants clinically cured after 10 days versus 21.2% with placebo.
findings.limitations: 105 adults; the very large between-group difference warrants confirmation against the full paper during verification

findings.endpoint: death rate in moderate-to-severe COVID-19 (add-on to standard of care)
findings.finding_summary: In this double-blind multicenter placebo-controlled phase III trial, the thymosin α1 arm was reported with a lower death rate (11.1%) than the placebo arm (38.5%), alongside shortened hospitalization and oxygen-support duration.
findings.limitations: n=105 (40 severe, 65 moderate); single-country trial; read alongside the 2025 TESTS sepsis null for the broader mortality picture
